title: Apple rolls out Retention Messaging, letting developers present personalized text, images, or special offers to users who are canceling their subscriptions (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
summary: Marcus Mendes / 9to5Mac: Apple rolls out Retention Messaging, letting developers present personalized text, images, or special offers to users who are canceling their subscriptions — Apple today rolled out a new subscription retention tool for developers looking to reduce cancellations. Here are the details.
